cases.action: Inspect font family, body size, line-height, heading size, and radius variables in globals.css and layout.tsx
cases.expected: Font-sans: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; Body: 14px (text-sm) leading 1.5; Heading: 22px (text-[1.375rem]) semibold normal tracking; Mono: monospace; Radius: 4px base, 8px panel
cases.observed: globals.css:121-127 defines --font-sans, --font-mono, --radius: 0.25rem (4px), --radius-lg: calc(var(--radius) + 0.25rem) (8px). Body at line 147 has 'font-sans text-sm leading-[1.5]'. PageHeader (page-header.tsx:17) uses 'text-[1.375rem] leading-snug font-semibold tracking-normal'. Geist font successfully eliminated.

cases.action: Verify distinct semantic color variables for the 5 independent state axes and ensure no conflation into binary success/failure
cases.expected: Execution: #364152; Verification: #236341; Dependency Ready: #174ea6; Dependency Blocked: #8a2925; Timing: #775317; Attention: #783e14; Error: #a12622; Header: #101820
cases.observed: globals.css:15-46 defines distinct CSS tokens for each axis. WorkBadges (work-badges.tsx) maps execution, verification, dependency, timing, and attention independently without conflating completed execution with verified status.

cases.action: Inspect row height classes, cell padding, and multi-line title wrapping across comfortable vs compact density settings
cases.expected: Comfortable: min 44px row height, 8px vertical padding (h-11 or py-2.5), 14px body; Compact: min 36px row height, 4px vertical padding (h-9 or py-1), 14px body; Long titles wrap naturally without truncation
cases.observed: work-grid.tsx:75 sets cell='px-3 py-2.5' (comfortable) vs 'px-2 py-1' (compact). Line 113 sets row class to density === 'compact' ? 'h-9' : 'h-11' (36px vs 44px). RowTitleEdit wraps inside max-w-xs with break-words. Text remains 14px text-sm in both densities.

cases.action: Audit [data-theme='dark'] tokens, contrast ratios, and preservation of 5-axis semantics in dark mode
cases.expected: Accessible dark background (oklch), light text, distinct dark tokens for 5 axes, no raw white light tokens leaking into dark theme
cases.observed: globals.css:53-84 provides full OKLCH dark theme mapping. Dark theme defines --background, --foreground, --card, --border, and dark equivalents for --execution, --verification, --dependency-ready, --dependency-blocked, --timing, --attention. Theme toggle script in theme.ts sets data-theme before hydration.

cases.action: Audit CSS media queries for touch targets (min 44px / 2.75rem), table horizontal scrolling, and responsive navigation
cases.expected: Mobile/coarse pointer controls: min-height 44px (2.75rem). Data tables retain min-width with scoped overflow-x-auto, no accidental full-page horizontal blowouts. Mobile menu drawer for narrow viewports.
cases.observed: globals.css:172-185 enforces @media (max-width: 639px), (pointer: coarse) min-height: 2.75rem (44px) on buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, and a[data-control]. WorkGrid table wrapper uses overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border with table min-w-[56rem]. MobileNav (mobile-nav.tsx) renders drawer on mobile.

cases.action: Examine sizing units across typography, form fields, and layout wrappers for hardcoded fixed pixel height clipping
cases.expected: Text sizes in rem/em, fluid container heights (min-height instead of fixed height), text wraps without truncation or clipping
cases.observed: Body uses text-sm (0.875rem), PageHeader uses text-[1.375rem]. Sizing uses min-height (h-9, h-11 are min-heights in table rows via align-top and wrapping text). No fixed-height clipping on legal content or audit logs. Physical browser pixel measurement blocked pending runtime cue.

cases.requirement: R9 UIUX / Full Keyboard & Visible Focus
cases.action: Audit focus ring styles, tab navigation order, skip link, and dialog modal focus trapping and escape handling
cases.expected: Focus ring 2px outline with 2px offset; skip-to-content link present; native dialog uses showModal() with focus trap and Escape key restore
cases.observed: globals.css:156 sets :focus-visible { outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-ring }. app-header.tsx:206 sets header focus outline to white. dashboard-template.tsx:22 includes accessible Skip to content link. dialog.tsx uses native HTMLDialogElement with showModal() and onClose listener restoring prior focus.

cases.requirement: R9 UIUX / A11y & Screen Reader Verification
cases.action: Audit ARIA landmarks, table captions, role attributes, live regions, and screen-reader readiness
cases.expected: Semantic table, caption.sr-only, th scope=col/row, aria-live regions for record counts, aria-describedby for errors; physical assistive screen reader verification reported accurately
cases.observed: Source implements proper ARIA semantics: caption sr-only, th scope=col/row, aria-live=polite on counts, aria-current=step on filing stages. However, physical assistive screen reader execution (VoiceOver/NVDA) is NOT available in this headless environment; marked VERIFICATION_BLOCKED for live screen-reader claim.

cases.action: Audit triage section ordering, boundary timestamp declaration, sourceRevision, and deep links
cases.expected: Triage order: Blockers -> Next actions -> Waiting on -> Milestones -> Scope gaps -> Recent changes. As-of snapshot declared. Every row links to record with truthful from query parameter.
cases.observed: control-room-view.tsx:84 displays 'As of <time dateTime={room.asOf}>{room.asOf}</time> · source revision {room.sourceRevision}'. Sections render in exact approved triage sequence. Record links append ?from=/matters/[matterId]/control-room.

cases.requirement: R9 UIUX / My Actions & Scope Strip
cases.action: Verify 4 distinct sections of My Actions, unassigned handling, and MatterScope breadcrumb strip
cases.expected: My Actions separated into Next actions (ready), Waiting on others, Blocked, Completed/cancelled. MatterScope shows Workspace ID, Matter title, caller role badge, and read timestamp.
cases.observed: my-actions-view.tsx:41-66 defines 4 distinct sections. MatterScope (matter-scope.tsx:26-46) displays Workspace link, matter title, callerRole badge, and 'Scope read at <asOf>' timestamp. Truthful withFrom preserves origin path.

cases.action: Audit audit history fields: cursor pagination, seq #, actorId/actorKind, target, recordedAt, effectiveAt, causeId, reason
cases.expected: Cursor pagination via nextCursor without invented total page count; exact server ordering; no invented actor or cause provenance
cases.observed: history/page.tsx:27-46 passes nextCursor to MatterHistory. matter-history.tsx:82-120 displays seq #, type, actorId with actorKind, targetKind/targetId, recordedAt, effectiveAt, causeId, reason. Empty state rendered honestly when zero events.

cases.action: Audit work item detail routing, execution vs verification status independence, and completion != verification
cases.expected: Requirement records what must be true (lifecycle/verification); Action records work (execution/assignment). An Action can be COMPLETED while UNVERIFIED. Completed does not automatically grant verified.
cases.observed: WorkItem page (work/[itemId]/page.tsx:93-100) branches cleanly on e.item.kind ('Requirement' vs 'Action'). WorkBadges renders ExecutionBadge and VerificationBadge as completely independent DOM elements. ExecutionPanel handles execution transitions; ProofPanel handles verification. No conflation exists.

cases.action: Audit evidence submission vs verifier assessment affordances, verifier candidate designation, and dispute handling
cases.expected: Evidence author cannot self-verify. Verifier must be designated. Non-verifiers receive 403 or disabled assessment. Disputes prevent satisfied derivation.
cases.observed: proof-panel.tsx:55 calculates isVerifier = checklist.verifiers.includes(checklist.callerId) && canWrite(ctx.role). Only authorized verifiers render assessment actions. Criteria revision and validity days enforced. Derivation message clearly states verification cannot be edited directly.

cases.action: Audit version list, promotion target select control, expected-current guard, and OWNER-only permission
cases.expected: 'Current' is an explicit decision by OWNER, never latest upload. Distinct promote-target selection separate from expected-current guard. R9-N03 fix verified.
cases.observed: DocumentView (documents/[documentId]/page.tsx:66-93) clarifies 'Current is an explicit decision by an owner, never the most recent upload'. Make current link restricted to role === 'OWNER'. PromoteForm (document-forms.tsx:102-140) provides promote-target select and expected version guard with promotion impact text.

cases.requirement: RULE-019 / Regulatory Filing Cycles & Negative Observations
cases.action: Audit filing stage stepper, negative outcome blocking message, signature requirement explanation, and cycles list
cases.expected: Stepper marks current step with aria-current=step. Negative outcome open blocks approval until closed/reopened. Observations append-only with correctsId.
cases.observed: filing-view.tsx:25-50 renders FILING_STAGES with aria-current='step'. When filing.negativeOpen is true, renders role=status border-destructive alert: 'A {filing.negativeOutcome} is recorded. The filing cannot be approved until an owner closes or reopens it.' Observations mapped via correctsId.

cases.action: Verify import preview displays importedVerificationClaim as an unverified source claim and never grants VERIFIED status
cases.expected: Preview displays importedVerificationClaim explicitly marked as 'unverified until proved here'; atomic causal events created on backend commit
cases.observed: import-section.tsx:211-214 checks r.importedVerificationClaim and displays: '— source verification claim: {r.importedVerificationClaim} (unverified until proved here)'. Schemas (schemas.ts:40) parses importedVerificationClaim as optional string. Unit test data-transfer-ui.test.tsx:416 verifies claim display.

cases.requirement: W6 / Bulk Edit Reconciliation & Slot Lock
cases.action: Audit bulk edit execution, per-row outcome list, and session attempt locking against concurrent submissions
cases.expected: Per-row status (SUCCESS, REJECTED, UNKNOWN); concurrent submission blocked while slot running; receipts cached until browser ACK
cases.observed: bulk-section.tsx:50-80 uses busy ref and session pendingTransfers lock. OutcomeList renders rowKey, status, and error message per item. Terminal response cached in attemptSlots until acknowledgeTransferAction releases it.

cases.requirement: CL-01 & CL-02 / Delta Status Brief & Export CSV Sanitization
cases.action: Audit brief generation against declared window t1..t2, missing provenance fail-closed, and CSV formula escape
cases.expected: Brief applies domain evaluator at t2; missing historical provenance fails brief-unreconstructable; CSV escapes =, +, -, @ to prevent spreadsheet injection
cases.observed: brief-section.tsx:75-120 handles brief generation. Backend brief_replay.go evaluates domain rules at t2 and returns brief-unreconstructable on missing inputs. Export route (/api/matters/[matterId]/export/route.ts) escapes formula characters as literal text.

cases.action: Verify page mount or browser reload of RecoveryGate does not POST a mutation, but reads retained attempt status
cases.expected: Mount runs recoverTransfersAction(matterId) read-only; withholds new forms until unresolved attempts are recovered or acknowledged
cases.observed: recovery-gate.tsx:17-39 invokes recoverTransfersAction on mount. recovery-gate.test.tsx:18 asserts 'never POSTs on mount; withholds new forms until explicit recovery and acknowledgement' (verified pass).

cases.requirement: CL-04 / Terminal Response Lost & ACK Unlock
cases.action: Verify retained terminal receipts are read without re-mutation and unlocked only upon explicit matching browser ACK
cases.expected: Terminal receipts presented for user confirmation ('Confirm recovered results'); acknowledgeTransferAction unlocks the server slot
cases.observed: recovery-gate.tsx:58-66 loops through recovered receipts, verifies no UNKNOWN rows, and calls acknowledgeTransferAction(matterId, kind, key). recovery-gate.test.tsx:45 asserts receipts show as acknowledgement without re-mutating.

cases.requirement: CL-04 / UNKNOWN Outcome Idempotency & CAS Re-read
cases.action: Verify receipted command re-uses original idempotency key and frozen payload on retry, while CAS command requires re-read
cases.expected: IntentForm freezes payload on outcome-unknown with retrySameKey=true; ConfirmActionButton blocks re-click until state is re-read via router.refresh()
cases.observed: intent-form.tsx:67-93 uses frozen.current payload and same idempotency key for retry. confirm-action-button.tsx:34-40 enforces requiresReread guard. Note: recovery.test.tsx:163 revealed an asynchronous transition timing issue under high parallel jsdom load, resolved when running sequentially.

cases.requirement: R8-N01 & CL-04 / Access-Loss Purge & Permanent Refusal Marker
cases.action: Verify access revocation purges protected payload from session slot and leaves refusal marker that re-grant cannot revive
cases.expected: revokeAttempts sets { blocked: matterId } clearing payload; beginAttempt refuses new or existing attempts if slot.blocked is set
cases.observed: pending-attempts.ts:83-90 deletes attempt payload and records slot={ blocked: matterId }. Line 62: beginAttempt checks 'if (slot?.blocked) return null'. RecoveryGate disables retry button if attempt.blocked is true. Re-grant never revives purged data.

cases.requirement: NFR-010 & R8-N02 / EN-VI Locale Switch Form Intent
cases.action: Verify toggling locale EN/VI does not wipe out form draft in sessionStorage and preserves user input
cases.expected: Draft values persisted in sessionStorage under opaque namespace + draftKey; locale toggle preserves draft values and does not translate legal user inputs
cases.observed: drafts.ts:23-48 stores drafts in sessionStorage keyed by namespace:scope. IntentForm onInput saves draft; useEffect restores draft on mount. drafts.test.tsx:90-120 verifies draft survival across rerenders and scope changes. User legal content passes through untouched.

cases.action: Perform full codebase inventory of Vietnamese translations vs hardcoded English strings
cases.expected: Audit identifies all localized components and lists every non-localized page, form, error message, and table header
cases.observed: Only MatterHistory, locale-toggle, and dashboard-template skip link consume useLocale/LocalizedText. All other screens (SCR-01..12), forms, alerts, dialogs, buttons, table headers, and error messages are hardcoded English string literals. NFR-010 cannot be marked PASS; status is PARTIAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY / CHANGES_REQUIRED.
cases.evidence: Grep audit: useLocale only in matter-history.tsx, locale-toggle.tsx, dashboard-template.tsx. All other features have no VI translation dictionary.

cases.action: Prepare complete participant task packet and facilitator scoring guide for 5 real managers
cases.expected: Participant packet contains Scenario A & B, tasks, and response sheet without answer keys. Facilitator guide contains scoring rubric (80% threshold) and answer key. Status truthfully marked AWAITING_HUMAN_TRIAL without fabricated data.
cases.observed: Prepared ac-137-participant-packet.md and ac-137-facilitator-guide.md as separate deliverables. Facilitator answer key strictly separated. Trial status recorded as NOT_RUN / AWAITING_HUMAN_TRIAL.
